The plugin works well and does exactly what we needed. Variant switching works properly, images are assigned to the right variants, and the setup is simple and easy to understand. The support team responded quickly and clearly, and helped us figure out an issue that was actually on our side. The only minor downside we noticed is that sometimes a video from one variant may also appear under another variant. The team is aware of this bug and said they are planning to fix it soon, so it’s not a major concern for us. Overall, a useful plugin with great support. Thank you!

LITERALLY all you do is set your product up like a variant, put your images in the order you want them and then DONE. Their 55 seconds video literally walks you through it and it is for real perfect. DONT waste any money using other apps for variant product images when this one is free and perfect.

The best and simplest app for variant images. Uses the Theme's gallery layout and no complex customisation options. Most importantly, I am still building the web shop and have only 10 products, so it's good to see how the end site will look like. I don't have sales yet as I have not launched. Other apps limit you to 1 or 5 products and/or request a monthly fee, which is understandable but absurd for a start-up with 10 products and 0 sales. I would not pay for that unless my shop is established. This app allowed me to add all my 10 products and visualise the web shop. And of course, if and when I ever have substantial sales it's very likely I will use it. Recommend it
